description: Wiring diagram: 8 existing mechanism nodes, 13 proposed new intermediate nodes, and the 9 phenotypes, with edges coloured by evidence grade
code:
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import networkx as nx

# EXISTING nodes (E), PROPOSED new nodes (P), PHENOTYPES (H)
E = {
 "E1":"Phagocytosis by\nalveolar macrophages",
 "E4":"Granuloma\nformation",
 "E6":"Tissue damage\n(cavitation, necrosis)",
}
P = {
 "P1":"Systemic pro-inflammatory\ncytokine response\n(TNF, IL-1b, IL-6)",
 "P2":"Skeletal muscle proteolysis,\nnegative nitrogen balance",
 "P3":"Gut PYY elevation,\nappetite suppression",
 "P4":"Hypothalamic PGE2\nset-point elevation",
 "P5":"Hepcidin-mediated iron\nsequestration, anaemia",
 "P6":"Endobronchial granulomatous\ninflammation, ulceration",
 "P7":"Cough reflex\nsensitisation",
 "P8":"Pulmonary artery erosion,\nRasmussen pseudoaneurysm",
 "P9":"Systemic arterial neovascular-\nisation with shunting",
 "P10":"Pleural space seeding",
 "P11":"Tuberculous pleuritis,\nparietal pleural granulomas",
 "P12":"Lymphatic spread to\ndraining regional nodes",
 "P13":"Granulomatous lymphadenitis,\nnodal effacement",
 "P14":"Haematogenous dissemination\n(Batson venous plexus)",
 "P15":"Tuberculous spondylodiscitis,\nbone and disc destruction",
}
H = {
 "H1":"Chronic cough","H2":"Fever","H3":"Night sweats","H4":"Weight loss",
 "H5":"Hemoptysis","H6":"Chest pain","H7":"Fatigue","H8":"Back pain",
 "H9":"Lymphadenopathy",
}
# edges: (u, v, grade)  grade in ESTABLISHED / SUPPORTED / WEAK (no human evidence)
edges = [
 ("E1","P1","SUPPORTED"),("E4","P1","SUPPORTED"),("E6","P1","SUPPORTED"),
 ("P1","P2","ESTABLISHED"),("P2","H4","ESTABLISHED"),
 ("P1","P3","SUPPORTED"),("P3","H4","SUPPORTED"),
 ("P1","P4","WEAK"),("P4","H2","WEAK"),
 ("P1","P5","SUPPORTED"),("P5","H7","WEAK"),
 ("E6","P6","SUPPORTED"),("P6","P7","WEAK"),("P7","H1","SUPPORTED"),
 ("E6","P8","SUPPORTED"),("P8","H5","ESTABLISHED"),
 ("E6","P9","SUPPORTED"),("P9","H5","ESTABLISHED"),
 ("E6","P10","SUPPORTED"),("P10","P11","SUPPORTED"),("P11","H6","WEAK"),
 ("E1","P12","WEAK"),("P12","P13","SUPPORTED"),("P13","H9","SUPPORTED"),
 ("P13","P6","SUPPORTED"),
 ("E4","P14","SUPPORTED"),("P14","P15","WEAK"),("P15","H8","SUPPORTED"),
]
G = nx.DiGraph(); G.add_edges_from([(u,v) for u,v,_ in edges])

# manual layout: columns by role, rows hand-placed for readability
pos = {
 "E1":(0,8.4),"E4":(0,5.2),"E6":(0,2.0),
 "P1":(1.6,9.6),"P2":(3.2,11.1),"P3":(3.2,9.6),"P4":(3.2,8.1),"P5":(3.2,6.6),
 "P12":(1.6,5.0),"P13":(3.2,5.0),
 "P14":(1.6,3.3),"P15":(3.2,3.3),
 "P6":(1.6,1.6),"P7":(3.2,1.6),
 "P8":(1.6,0.1),"P9":(1.6,-1.2),
 "P10":(1.6,-2.6),"P11":(3.2,-2.6),
 "H4":(5.0,10.4),"H2":(5.0,8.1),"H7":(5.0,6.6),"H9":(5.0,5.0),
 "H8":(5.0,3.3),"H1":(5.0,1.6),"H5":(5.0,-0.6),"H6":(5.0,-2.6),
 "H3":(5.0,12.2),
}
G.add_node("H3")

ecol = {"ESTABLISHED":"#1a5c38","SUPPORTED":"#4fa36f","WEAK":"#d98b3a"}
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(14.5, 10.5))
for u, v, g in edges:
    nx.draw_networkx_edges(G, pos, edgelist=[(u,v)], ax=ax, edge_color=ecol[g],
                           width=2.1 if g=="ESTABLISHED" else 1.5,
                           style="solid" if g!="WEAK" else (0,(4,3)),
                           arrowsize=13, node_size=5200, alpha=0.9)

def draw(keys, labels, fc, ec, shape="o"):
    nx.draw_networkx_nodes(G, pos, nodelist=keys, node_color=fc, edgecolors=ec,
                           node_size=5200, node_shape=shape, linewidths=1.6, ax=ax)
    nx.draw_networkx_labels(G, pos, labels={k:labels[k] for k in keys}, font_size=6.2, ax=ax)

draw(list(E), E, "#cfd8e3", "#3b4a5c", "s")
draw(list(P), P, "#fdf0d5", "#c08a2e")
draw(list(H), H, "#f2d7da", "#9e4b55", "d")

# night sweats sits unconnected
ax.annotate("no mechanism node:\nNOT_ESTABLISHED", xy=(5.0,12.2), xytext=(3.0,12.6),
            fontsize=7.5, color="#9e4b55", ha="center",
            arrowprops=dict(arrowstyle="->", color="#9e4b55", linestyle=":"))

from matplotlib.lines import Line2D
from matplotlib.patches import Patch
ax.legend(handles=[
    Patch(facecolor="#cfd8e3", edgecolor="#3b4a5c", label="Existing mechanism node"),
    Patch(facecolor="#fdf0d5", edgecolor="#c08a2e", label="Proposed new mechanism node"),
    Patch(facecolor="#f2d7da", edgecolor="#9e4b55", label="Phenotype (HPO)"),
    Line2D([0],[0], color=ecol["ESTABLISHED"], lw=2.1, label="Edge: ESTABLISHED"),
    Line2D([0],[0], color=ecol["SUPPORTED"], lw=1.5, label="Edge: SUPPORTED"),
    Line2D([0],[0], color=ecol["WEAK"], lw=1.5, ls="--", label="Edge: no human evidence located"),
], loc="lower left", fontsize=8.5, frameon=False)
ax.set_title("Mechanism-to-phenotype wiring for tuberculosis (MONDO:0018076): "
             "15 proposed intermediate nodes connect 3 existing mechanism nodes to 8 of 9 phenotypes",
             fontsize=11, loc="left")
ax.axis("off"); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()

print("Existing nodes used as anchors:", len(E))
print("Proposed new mechanism nodes:", len(P))
print("Phenotypes wired:", len(H)-1, "of", len(H))
print("Edges:", len(edges),
      "| ESTABLISHED", sum(1 for *_ ,g in edges if g=="ESTABLISHED"),
      "| SUPPORTED", sum(1 for *_ ,g in edges if g=="SUPPORTED"),
      "| no human evidence", sum(1 for *_ ,g in edges if g=="WEAK"))
